grid.anchor: global price grid (multiples of spacing_pips from price 0)

withdrawal.logic: Withdraw all balance above the initial stake after every basket close

filters.rollover_suppresses: deploy + market-order recovery (limit grid entries unaffected)

cooldown.description: Disabled (no cooldown gate). Multiple fills per hour permitted.

adaptive.cut_funding_source: lifetime realized profit on this account (NOT capital calls). Constraint: lifetime_cut_loss <= lifetime_realized_profit. Per-basket cap: cuts_this_basket <= stake_per_account.
